##### Project general facts

Radiant Elite Tower is a signature waterfront, ideally positioned on a prime plot in Shams Abu Dhabi, Al Reem Island. Rising 40 stories above the coastline, the tower offers panoramic views of the sea, the canal, mangroves, and even Saadiyat Island. Designed as a seamless blend of architectural elegance and modern urban living, Radiant Elite sits minutes from Abu Dhabi’s cultural, retail, and educational landmarks — bringing together exclusivity and convenience at the edge of the city and the water.

Residents enjoy access to a carefully curated set of amenities that promote well-being, recreation, and community. Highlights include a sea-view pool, a fully equipped gym, a padel court, kids' play areas, and serene private outdoor spaces in select units. The development also features a concierge lobby, retail outlets, an on-site nursery, prayer rooms, and a panoramic terrace. Radiant Elite Tower redefines everyday life with a vision rooted in coastal elegance, architectural distinction, and effortless connectivity.

The tower features finely crafted residences ranging from efficient studios to expansive 4-bedroom duplexes. Each unit is framed by floor-to-ceiling windows that maximize natural light and breathtaking views. With elegant interiors, premium finishes, built-in appliances, and thoughtful layouts, the residences are designed for comfort, flow, and refined modern living. Whether you're seeking compact functionality or family-sized luxury, Radiant Elite offers a diverse range of homes for every lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Reem Island is a rapidly developing mixed-use district located northeast of Abu Dhabi, approximately 1,970 feet from the emirate’s mainland. It is situated near Saadiyat Island and Al Maryah Island, forming a vibrant cluster of urban development.

The majority of residential complexes are positioned close to the sea and beaches, offering residents a resort-like lifestyle with easy access to the full range of city amenities. Al Reem Island boasts a comprehensive social and recreational infrastructure, including banks, commercial centers, lush parks, and sports facilities, making it a lively and convenient place to live.

As one of Abu Dhabi’s first freehold zones, Al Reem Island attracted significant investment in real estate development. The architecture is predominantly modern, with the exception of a select villa community that reflects classic Moroccan and Spanish design styles.
